text:
No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on this 2,843 ha property between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data covered the whole property (valid observations over 100% of it) through 2025.

Caveats:
- Hansen did record 0.4 ha of loss in small patches in 2021. That is below the 0.5 ha threshold, so it was not counted as an event.
- Changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed, so this does not prove that no change happened at all.
- Little tree cover was left to lose. The JRC map shows 0 ha of forest in 2020, and Hansen shows only 23 ha of tree cover in 2000.
- Most loss came earlier: about 99 ha across 2008, 2015, 2017 and 2020, with 67.7 ha in 2020. These fall outside the 2021–2025 window.

This is not a regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR status.
